summary: Airalo's eSIM page for Spain, with six plans from 3 to 30 days, so your phone has data on arrival.
body:
## What this listing is

This is Airalo's eSIM page for Spain. An eSIM is a data plan you install on a phone that supports it, so you can be online when you land without buying a physical SIM. The page is titled "Spain eSIM, from 4.00 €" and sells plans for Spain only; broader plans are linked separately.

## The plans listed

Under the Unlimited filter the listing showed these packages when we read it:

- 3 days: 10.50 €
- 5 days: 15.50 €
- 7 days: 21.50 €
- 10 days: 29.50 €
- 15 days: 39.50 €
- 30 days: 57.50 €

That is 10.50 € for 3 days at the short end and 57.50 € for 30 days at the long end. Worked out per day, the best value on the list is the 30-day plan at about 1.92 € a day, and the shortest plan costs about 3.50 € a day. The page also has filters for data-only, unlimited and fixed-data packages, so a smaller fixed-data plan may be cheaper than anything above.

## Coverage beyond Spain

If your trip crosses borders, the page points to European Union and United Kingdom eSIMs from 4.00 €. These are separate products, so compare them against the Spain plans before you buy.

## Network and setup

The page does not name the network in the text we read; open the listing to see which network a plan uses. Airalo says installation takes minutes and that you can install before you leave, which matters because you need a connection to download the eSIM profile. Check that your phone supports eSIM and is not locked to a carrier using the compatibility link on the page.

## Support

The page states 24/7 support in several languages, including chat on WhatsApp, and an app in 53 languages. Airalo also says over 30 million people use it; that is the company's own claim, not ours.

## When it fits

It suits a short city trip, such as a few days in Barcelona, where you want maps and tickets on your phone from arrival. If you use very little data, compare against your home plan's roaming price first.
